Container.Name: recipe-planner
Container.Overview: Self-hosted, pantry-first weekly dinner planner for a household. Discovers recipes from HelloFresh and your local Mealie library, scores them against what you already have on hand, builds a combined shopping list, and can push it straight to a Bring! shopping list. Image is built automatically by GitHub Actions from https://github.com/rgabrielson11/recipe-planner on every push to master.
Container.Requires: A running Mealie instance on your network (for recipe storage/import), and optionally a Bring! account (for shopping-list push).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web UI listens on inside the container

Config.Name: Database
Config.Description: SQLite database storage — back this up before updating

Config.Name: YAML Config
Config.Description: Hand-editable YAML config: pantry staples, recipe sources, package sizes, rejection reasons, cooking vocabulary

Config.Name: Mealie Base URL
Config.Description: Your self-hosted Mealie instance URL, no trailing slash (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:9000)

Config.Name: Mealie API Token
Config.Description: Service account token — generate in Mealie -> Profile -> API Tokens

Config.Name: Bring! Email
Config.Description: Bring! account email — leave blank to disable the Push to Bring! button

Config.Name: Bring! Password
Config.Description: Bring! account password — leave blank to disable the Push to Bring! button

Config.Name: Homepage Dashboard URL
Config.Description: LAN URL for Homepage dashboard auto-discovery, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8111 (optional)

Config.Name: Database Path
Config.Description: SQLite file path inside the container — change only if you also change the Database volume mapping

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone — affects nightly scrape schedule and week calculations. Use a TZ database name e.g. America/New_York, Europe/London, Australia/Sydney

Config.Name: Ollama Base URL
Config.Description: Local Ollama instance URL for LLM ingredient normalisation — e.g. http://192.168.111.189:11434. Leave blank to disable.

Config.Name: Ollama Model
Config.Description: Ollama model for ingredient normalisation. Recommended: qwen3:latest or gemma3:4b

Config.Name: Ollama Timeout
Config.Description: Seconds to wait for Ollama response before giving up and using fallback
